roleContext.jobDescription: The online banking channel serves the bank's retail customers through the web and mobile apps, and every change to it reaches customers through a release the Release Manager runs. The manager takes releases through the go-live weekend into the live channel, holds the release calendar and the go-live checklist, runs the post-release watch with operations and calls a rollback when the customer error rate rises, and records the boundary of each release afterwards. Reports to the head of channel delivery; works with the channel engineering teams, operations, the change advisory board and customer support.

requirements.text: Has taken channel releases through the go-live weekend into the live channel used by customers.
Holds the release calendar for the live channel and the go-live checklist.
Runs the post-release watch with operations and calls a rollback when the customer error rate rises.
Prepares each release through the change advisory board with a documented readiness review.
Records residual risks and hand-over conditions for each release.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Release Manager, Online Banking Channel

## Experience

- Took twenty-two releases of the online banking channel through the go-live weekend into the live channel between 2022 and 2025, holding the release calendar and the go-live checklist for the channel throughout.
- Ran the post-release watch with operations on each go-live weekend and called two rollbacks, both when the customer error rate on the login journey rose above the agreed threshold; both are recorded in the change records with their timings.
- Prepared every release through the change advisory board with a readiness review, keeping the readiness review minutes and the board's approval reference for each release in the release folder.
- Recorded the residual risks and the hand-over conditions for each release in the release closure note, including the customer-facing limitations that stayed open after go-live.
- Before the release manager role, two years as a release coordinator on the same channel, running the go-live checklist under the previous release manager.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the release calendar for 2024, the go-live checklist, the change records for the two rollbacks and the release closure notes for the last four releases, with the change advisory board references as a verification trail.
